versions.subject: add file_event_mal_vhd_download
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith:
        - chrome.exe 
        - firefox.exe
        - microsoftedge.exe
        - microsoftedgecp.exe
        - msedge.exe
    - TargetFilename|contains: '.vhd' #not endswith to get the alternate data stream log Too TargetFilename: C:\Users\Frack113\Downloads\windows.vhd:Zone.Identifier
condition: selection
